result.summary: Found 1 major content issue on the page: an invalid discount percentage displayed on a restaurant card.

issues.description: The promotional badge on the bottom restaurant card (under 'Popular right now') displays an unrealistic '-100%' discount, indicating a calculation or data binding error.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values before rendering and cap or hide invalid promotional badges (e.g., 100% off or negative values caused by missing price data).
